Are you two close friends? Family maybe? Cherish it. You think I disregard the well-being of Fables like Dum or Jersey? Fuck you. When shit goes bad and a Fable's lying on the ground. My job forces me to ask , who do I have to explain why they haven't come home yet--or never will again.

I'm sick and tired of having to put down some puffed up, ego-crazed muscle bag simply because they're standing between me and my responsibility. I've been in this malodorous city, doing this thankless job, going toe-to-toe with the same shit-for-brains goons for a long fucking time. I suggest you think real long and hard whether you two might actually be the ones to break the streak.

I get what you're doing. The Crooked Man provides you a purpose in this mundy-ridden, tortured life. But don't mistake purpose for protection. He can't guarantee you survive this. Worse yet, what if you survive but your buddy here doesn't?

At the end of this, before you black out and watch helplessly as I decide if your friend is better off dead or alive, ask yourself if it was worth losing her over it. Because sometimes you don't get a choice. Sometimes you lose Snow whether you like it or--
On 2nd thought, fuck you.
[FIGHT]

[KILL HER]
